title: Critical Path Resolution Complete — Framework Production-Ready
summary: All 3 critical gaps resolved in single session. Framework now has: measured context reporting, scope-aware lug routing, interruption recovery with autosave. Ozi autonomous orchestration now unblocked.
description: Session 74 implemented all three gaps identified in Session 73 in parallel. Framework went from partial (no context measurement, no routing awareness, no interruption recovery) to production-ready (all three mechanisms implemented, tested, integrated). This represents completion of foundational work needed for Ozi autonomous dispatch.
learning: Large architectural work can be completed in a single focused session when: (1) previous session identified gaps clearly, (2) implementation is distributed across orthogonal concerns, (3) verification is built-in. Avoided rework by testing routing gate with simulated lugs before integration.
implications: Framework is now production-ready for real-world deployments
Ozi can dispatch work autonomously with confidence in routing and recovery
All spokes can now handle interruptions gracefully
Teaching pipeline is unblocked (signals can route to hub)
